snippet.title: Cats & Cakes – The Cozy Card Game First Reveal!
snippet.description:
🎉 It’s official! Our Steam page for Cats & Cakes: The Card Game is now live!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3718610/Cats__Cakes_The_Card_Game/

🐾 Stack cards. Bake pastries. Serve quirky cats. Run the coziest cat bakery ever.

👉 Wishlist now on Steam and follow our journey toward launch! Every wishlist helps a small indie team like ours reach more cozy gamers. 💖

Demo release - To be announced soon!
